governance.priority: Existing qualified/active NCI-04, ITD-01, BIO, Mass Research, Optimizer native learning, Q21 successor and FORGE remain unchanged and prioritized.
prohibited: Protected Q21/Q21N01 and FSA first-use consumption
Changing previously frozen protocols or scientific negatives
New controller, scheduler, science queue or dispatch authority
Claiming LLM-level capability from toy semantics
governance.authority: CKB-plane remains the sole orchestration authority. FORGE performs delegated qualifications only, none required for L1 source-only CI.

north_star: Language is an expression of learned non-transformer cognition, never a replacement for independent native reasoning, transfer, continual learning and persistent memory.
new_portfolio: Reusable learned linguistic structures with novel semantic combinations
l1_question: Can factorized meaning-to-surface realization preserve semantic fidelity on held-out combinations with less sequential inference work than a sequentially emitted, equally informed learned reference?

semantic_fields.source_semantic_state: five public integer slots: actor, verb, object, modifier, negated; no hidden reasoning or future target
semantic_fields.languages: English only; one bounded synthetic canonical register

source_law.composition_holdout: Hold out predicate (actor+2*verb+3*object+modifier+negated)%7==0 for all FIT roles; DEV_COMPOSE draws only from holdout. Each ID value appears in FIT; preserve no memorized exact five-field tuple in DEV.
source_law.training_selection: All FIT_TRAIN/SELECT combinations selected from nonholdout; distinct seeded samples and content identities; forbid duplicate exact semantic tuples across FIT/SELECT by canonical deterministic role-partition.
source_law.dev: DEV_COMPOSE role never used to fit, choose an architecture, or tune generation/repair thresholds.
source_law.null: L1_PUBLIC_NULL supplies novel five-field semantics with intentionally permuted target-token alignment; target mismatch is NOT plausible natural language. Use only as leakage/null diagnostic, never as language quality benchmark.
source_law.grammar: <bos> the ACTOR will [not] VERB the OBJECT MODIFIER . <eos>, all lexemes fixed by PUBLIC source oracle and unknown to learning models until FIT examples; lexical meaning map remains hidden from learner inference.
source_law.source_scope: All language/fidelity tests in L1 are explicitly synthetic and English-only; not real natural-language creative generation, coding or reasoning.

candidate_families.parallel_concept_to_phrase: Learn categorical lexical realization and compositional phrase assembly exclusively from FIT inputs/targets; independently predict semantic-linked phrase components, then deterministic merge.
candidate_families.sequential_learned_reference: A properly trained conditional recurrent autoregressive reference to be introduced under its own precommitted identity before any L1 DEV exposure.
candidate_families.state_space_reference: A properly trained conditional state-space reference, likewise subject to separate precommit/qualification.
candidate_families.nonautoregressive_reference: A learned non-autoregressive output baseline with same input/target exposure and prospectively defined capacity options.
candidate_families.selective_repair: Separate frozen corruption/null provenance and trained verifier; any accepted repair must improve actual fidelity net of compute and latency.

comparison_rules.capacity: Prospectively declared small/medium capacities allowed; selection only FIT_SELECT; no DEV-tuned capacity, epochs, hyperparameters or verbalization.
comparison_rules.information: All contenders see identical semantic inputs and FIT target text; no direct test-time access to source oracle, hidden dictionaries or role labels.
comparison_rules.source_fidelity: Exact token-match, semantic-slot accuracy, polarity fidelity, novelty by tuple identity, hallucination/omission/word-order errors, and explicit failure/abstention.
comparison_rules.cost: Total training CPU, fit FLOPs estimate, sequential inference critical path, wall latency, measured inference CPU, peak RAM, persistent checkpoint and runtime storage; energy only when actual measured instrumentation exists.
comparison_rules.quality_scope: Measure any reasoning, coding, mathematics, multilingual, creativity or long-context ability ONLY when that domain has a qualified dataset; mark not tested otherwise.
comparison_rules.pareto: No superiority claim until trained recurrent, state-space and nonautoregressive comparators satisfy matched information AND defensible capacity/compute controls, and independent evaluation confirms no unacceptable fidelity regression.
comparison_rules.evidence: Source hashes, model/checkpoint hashes, native Windows/Linux reproducibility, negatives, null-false-positive rates, and immutable source custody preserved.

exit_conditions.engineering: Native Win/Linux source-only focused tests and repository Go regression and one full PR regression pass.
exit_conditions.science: NOT ELIGIBLE from L1 source qualification. Candidate training, conventional matched controls, independent sourced unfamiliar families, no negative domain regressions required separately.
exit_conditions.integration: No native Wingless, Yggdrasil or language-model rebuild from this stage.
